name: redreamality.github.io
description: 个人博客与项目展示网站，分享技术文章和个人见解

scripts.visual-kit:test: uv run --no-project python -B tools/visual-explainer-kit/test_builder.py && uv run --no-project python -B tools/visual-explainer-kit/test_generate_demos.py
scripts.visual-kit:build: uv run --no-project python -B tools/visual-explainer-kit/build.py --output dist/visual-kit/full && uv run --no-project python -B tools/visual-explainer-kit/build.py --output dist/visual-kit/minimal --locales en --no-overview --step-limit 1 && uv run --no-project python -B tools/visual-explainer-kit/build.py --manifest manifest-agents.json --output dist/visual-kit/agents --locales en && uv run --no-project python -B tools/visual-explainer-kit/build.py --manifest manifest-air-conditioner.json --output dist/visual-kit/air-conditioner
scripts.visual-kit:loop-engineering: uv run --no-project python -B tools/visual-explainer-kit/build.py --manifest manifest-loop-engineering.json --output src/assets/html-pages/loop-engineering
scripts.visual-kit:air-conditioner: uv run --no-project python -B tools/visual-explainer-kit/build.py --manifest manifest-air-conditioner.json --output src/assets/html-pages/air-conditioner
scripts.visual-kit:e2e: pnpm visual-kit:test && pnpm visual-kit:build && playwright test --config=tools/visual-explainer-kit/playwright.config.ts
